messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected on /v1/streaming/generate — p95=420ms (SLO 200ms), p99=1.9s. Error type: streaming stalls (partial responses, stalled frames). Rolling 5m window shows spike starting 2026-03-15T02:46:00Z. Paging: on-call.
Tilly (oncall): ack — I’m on it. Paging SREs and ML infra. @Sam @Nisha @Marco — please join.
Sam (sre): joining. Any recent deploys?
Nisha (mlops): I rolled a precision profile update to the int8+fp8 mix for many models ~20m ago (auto-calib toggle). Could be related.
Marco (infra): Noted. No infra changes from infra side in the last hour.
Tilly (oncall): customer impact? Elaine?
Elaine (customer-ops): We have 3 customers reporting slow streaming sessions, one ticket escalated. ETA for CS update?
Tilly (oncall): Give me a minute, triage first. Sam/Nisha — quick checks: metrics, KV cache hit rate, and any 503s?
Sam (sre): Looking at metrics: backend CPU/GPU utilization normal, but per-request tail latencies jump at the transformer kernel layer. KV cache hit rate steady. No 5xx spike, but connections show stalled reads on streaming sockets.
Nisha (mlops): Calibration / precision profile rollout log:
```
2026-03-15T02:24:12Z APPLY PROFILE model:chat-xl v2 -> precision: int8+fp8 (auto-calib ON)
2026-03-15T02:25:01Z ROLLOUT batch: 10% -> 30% -> 50%
2026-03-15T02:40:00Z ROLLOUT 100%
```
Tilly (oncall): That aligns with start of spike. Could be calibration fallout causing KV/attention dequant behavior. Nisha, can you temporarily revert the profile or pin the model to prior fp16 variant?
Nisha (mlops): I can revert. Plan A: roll model back to fp16 for affected model group. Plan B: toggle auto-calib off. Which should we do first?
Sam (sre): Rollback to fp16 is safest for latency. Toggle auto-calib may stop future drift but rollback gives immediate mitigation.
Marco (infra): If we rollback, routing needs to avoid the new quantized variant. I’ll open a routing policy patch to force serve-variant=fp16 for the group.
Tilly (oncall): Do it. Nisha, execute rollback and post the command you run. Sam/Marco, monitor streaming stall metrics and open a short-lived canary route. Elaine will prep customer comms.
Nisha (mlops): Running rollback now:
```
# rollback to pinned fp16 model variant
redwoodctl model rollout --model chat-xl:v2 --variant fp16 --force --group "prod-streaming" --reason "emergency rollback: streaming stalls"
```
Tilly (oncall): ETA on rollback completion?
Nisha (mlops): API reports rollout started. Estimated 90s for worker restart/attach.
Sam (sre): I see a drop in tail p99 starting ~45s after rollout start. p99 down from 1.9s -> 600ms so far. p95 trending to 220ms. Still above SLO but improving.
Marco (infra): Routing policy applied to prevent any new traffic to int8/fp8 pool. Old sessions still draining; we’ll force drain after 3m if needed.
Elaine (customer-ops): Patch note for customers: "We’re actively mitigating a performance regression affecting streaming tail latencies by rolling back a recent precision profile change. Some customers may see transient reconnections as traffic is moved back to the previous model variant. We’ll update in 30 minutes."
Tilly (oncall): Good. Sam — capture logs for stalled streams and include a sample stack trace and trace IDs. We need to confirm whether stall is due to dequant kernel deadlock or KV-cache invalidation.
Sam (sre): Capturing traces now. Sample trace id: t-9c3b4a. Stack shows long waits inside dequant CUDA kernel invocation, thread queues piling up.
Nisha (mlops): That suggests kernel path incompatibility for certain sequence lengths; our auto-calib may have selected a quant path that introduces tail contention for streaming prefix-heavy workloads.
Tilly (oncall): Action items so far: 1) Rollback completed? 2) Monitor SLOs and customer impact 3) Collect traces and logs for root cause 4) If rollback successful, schedule postmortem and revert rollout process.
Nisha (mlops): Rollback finished at 2026-03-15T02:51:32Z. Confirming new sessions are on fp16.
Sam (sre): p99 now at 310ms, p95 180ms. SLO restored. No new stall reports in last 2m.
Elaine (customer-ops): Updating customers: sending the update now.
Marco (infra): Draining int8/fp8 pool completed; I’ve quarantined the pool for investigation (no auto-reuse).
Tilly (oncall): Nice work. We’ll keep this thread for postmortem notes. Nisha, follow up with a regression repro plan: sequence lengths, KV cache scenarios, and exact quant profile parameters. Sam/Marco — save kernel-level traces for CUDA team. Elaine — gather customer impact timeline and ticket links.
Nisha (mlops): Will do. For immediate follow-up: disable auto-calib rollout until we have a canary harness for streaming paths. I’ll open a rollback RCA ticket and include the rollout artifact id.
Sam (sre): Adding notes: possible mitigations for future: stricter canary on streaming endpoints, dynamic fallback to fp16 on detected stall patterns, and kernel-level watchdogs to preempt deadlock.
Tilly (oncall): Thanks all. Closing paging. If anything spikes again, re-open this thread and escalate to oncall bridge. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: SLOs restored to baseline. Incident closed at 2026-03-15T02:56:00Z.
